40:t_008:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Too bad...! I anticipated that position.」

40:t_009:1.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Those three months of interception drills weren't just for show, you know.」

40:t_009:3.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「We won't make it in time!」

40:t_010:2.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Our atmospheric entry angle is off! At this rate...!」

40:t_011:1.en:
$$ボビー$$
「The $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$...!」

40:t_011:2.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Hurry, recover all units! The $$クォーター$$ is entering the atmosphere too!」

40:t_012:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「If they descend at that angle, atmospheric friction will turn that mothership into one mother of a bang.」

40:t_012:1.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Ha ha... A mothership making a mother of a bang. Even I admit that was a terrible pun.」

40:t_012:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Well... I've fulfilled the bare minimum of my duties. Let's leave the rest to $$ギルター$$.」

40:t_013:0.en:
$$アル$$
「Not bad, Sergeant! Keep ripping them apart and tossing them aside, one after another, and finish this up already!」

40:t_013:2.en:
$$アル$$
「What good is a wishy-washy answer like that!? You've got to fire yourself up!」

40:t_013:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$アル$$... That way you're speaking...」

40:t_013:4.en:
$$アル$$
「Yes, I modeled it on Miss $$千鳥$$. I asked her to advise me as the most effective way to understand you, Sergeant. This is the result.」

40:t_013:5.en:
$$アル$$
「Was it not to your liking?」

40:t_013:7.en:
$$アル$$
「I find that difficult to understand. I determined that this manner of speaking would motivate you most effectively.」

40:t_013:8.en:
$$宗介$$
「If you claim to be so advanced, come up with something original instead of imitating someone else!」

40:t_100:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$アル$$, what were you discussing with $$千鳥$$ before we deployed?」

40:t_100:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「We're in combat. Answer me at once.」

40:t_100:3.en:
$$アル$$
「I was simply exploring my own methods of improving combat efficiency.」

40:t_100:4.en:
$$アル$$
「In time, I should be able to show you the results, Sergeant.」

40:t_100:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「If you're that confident, I'll look forward to it.」

40:t_101:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Oh, my... How young. Your youthful freshness shines through even in the way you fly.」

40:t_101:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「This guy...! He talks like a joker, but he's skilled!」

40:t_101:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Ha ha ha, I hear that often. ...Not that I intend to change.」

40:t_101:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「Then I'll shut you up myself!」

40:t_101:4.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Thank you for taking the trouble to answer my banter. That, too, is a sign of youth.」

40:t_102:0.en:
$$甲児$$
「His machine...! It's in a different league from the other mass-produced units!」

40:t_102:1.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Well, I am the commander. They let me pilot something befitting my position.」

40:t_102:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「But your machine seems to be quite a masterpiece itself.」

40:t_102:3.en:
$$甲児$$
「I don't care about compliments from the enemy!」

40:t_102:4.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Yet you can't hide your smile as you say that. Ah, youth. Now, please do me the honor of a bout!」

40:t_103:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Now that's an unusual type of machine... Truly something unique to Earth.」

40:t_103:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「Are you referring to the $$アーバレスト$$?」

40:t_103:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「The ability to build such machines must be what makes the planet Earth so exceptional...」

40:t_103:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「I don't understand what you're talking about, but right now, I'll carry out my mission...!」

40:t_103:4.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Such single-mindedness... Truly a privilege of youth.」

40:t_104:0.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Here I come, old man! Don't think you can stop us!」

40:t_104:1.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Well, well... Even among all you young people, this one is exceptionally young.」

40:t_104:2.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「If you take me lightly because I'm a kid, you'll be sorry!!」

40:t_104:3.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Hmm... Even I didn't see this coming. So young... Far too young!」

40:t_105:1.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Ha ha ha, playing with dolls? You're less a young man than a little child.」

40:t_105:2.en:
$$正太郎$$
「I know what you're up to! You're trying to throw us off our rhythm and make us angry on purpose!」

40:t_105:3.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Oh, my... It seems this boy knows society's dark side and how dirty adults can be.」

40:t_105:4.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「In that case, I'll have to subdue you by force. Let me show you the power of an adult.」

40:t_106:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Oh, my... So you're the new $$スフィア・リアクター$$ I've heard about.」

40:t_106:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「You see... Despite appearances, I've had quite a few dealings with Reactors...」

40:t_106:3.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Vast as the galaxy is, I may be the only person to have met so many Reactors in person.」

40:t_106:5.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Oh, how frightening. The fearlessness of youth really is a terrifying thing.」

40:t_106:6.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「But it seems you haven't mastered your $$スフィア$$ at all yet. That's a relief, at least.」

40:t_106:7.en:
$n
「I don't give a damn about the $$スフィア$$'s power...! I'll just keep fighting in this $$ジェニオン$$!」

uncertain: 40:t_012:0-1: bokan (mothership/explosion) pun adapted to mothership / mother of a bang; the atmospheric-friction danger and his admission of a terrible pun are preserved.
notes: Al imitates Kaname for his first two enthusiastic lines, then returns to formal speech when he explains her advice. Sousuke objects to the imitation and asks for an original approach. Sardias provokes each young pilot while respecting their actual capability.
